summary.intent: Restore a Claude Code statusline hook file that was deleted by a GSD framework update and push the fix to GitHub.
summary.outcome: Successfully restored .claude/hooks/statusline.js from a prior commit and pushed the fix; settings.json already referenced it correctly.

repo: GSD framework updates (at least v1.30.0 and a prior version) repeatedly nuke .claude/hooks/statusline.js — this has happened at least twice, with commit 96a50cb37 being the previous restore.
settings.json references statusline.js and survived the GSD update intact.

code.finding: File is not protected from GSD framework bulk updates; must be manually restored after each GSD upgrade.

workflow: When a GSD update wipes custom files, the canonical recovery path is git history — specifically git show <commit>:<path> to extract a prior version.
Checking settings.json references after restoring hook files is a good verification step.

friction: GSD framework updates silently delete custom files in .claude/hooks/ without warning — this is a recurring problem requiring manual intervention after every upgrade.
open_items: No mechanism exists to protect .claude/hooks/statusline.js from being overwritten by future GSD updates — consider adding a post-update hook or documentation note to re-check this file after every GSD upgrade.
